findings.title: Fenced progress store deadlocks resume: reload() throws StaleFenceError for any previously-dispatched runId
findings.explanation: orchestrate() recreates the tracker and calls reload() before any claimCursor, so fencingToken is still null; loadProgress throws StaleFenceError when a fence row exists. Any run that once dispatched a node wrote that fence row, so durable recovery of that runId crashes at startup before recovery logic can run.
findings.impact: Restarting any previously-dispatched run is impossible via orchestrate() alone; operators must use raw store tooling. The only passing test sets the fencing token manually, masking the gap.
findings.remediationSketch: Treat load-without-token as read-only when a fence exists (return snapshot with a fenced flag), or claim the run-level fence in the orchestrator before reload(); add a resume regression test driven through orchestrate() alone.

findings.title: One failed progress persist poisons every later write; flush() hides the divergence
findings.explanation: Persist expectedRevision assumes all earlier writes landed. After one failure (SQLITE_BUSY, store closed), every later write conflicts forever while local revision keeps advancing; flush() returns the never-rejecting chain so the terminal receipt persists over a stale durable document.
findings.impact: Silent divergence between in-memory and durable progress; restart resumes from stale state and the failure is invisible in the receipt.
findings.remediationSketch: On CAS failure re-read and rebase the stored snapshot (validate transitions) and retry; surface the first chain error from flush() or expose hasPersistFailures() checked before persistTerminalReceipt.

findings.title: Movement tests race real timers against the poller and burn 17.5s of sleeps
findings.explanation: MV-B/C require the 2s poller tick to observe a 1.5s-written partial before the 6s child completes - a sub-second margin under CI load; MV-D needs the tick inside [1.5s, 3s). Total suite adds ~17.5s of pure sleep. No fake-clock injection exists.
findings.impact: The flagship movement assertions are flaky under load and slow the suite; intermittent CI failures will erode trust in exactly the tests that pin the progress-movement fixes.
findings.remediationSketch: Accept a pollIntervalMs orchestrate option (default 2000) and set it to ~10ms in tests with childMs ~50-100ms; or inject a fake clock. Keep the same assertions.

findings.title: Run-loop and review-path throws escape orchestrate() with no terminal receipt, intent resolution, or flush
quotedSnippets: result = jsonProjection(\n  capOutputSize(await invokeAdapter(request, cursorId, dispatchIntent?.intentId))\n);
findings.explanation: No catch exists between executeNode and the orchestrate() export: an adapter rejection, a JSON.stringify throw in capOutputSize (raw result stringified before jsonProjection), or the non-timeout re-throws in the review/remediation paths (four sites) escape with no terminal receipt, unresolved dispatch intent, unflushed progress/telemetry.
findings.impact: A run that dies this way leaves no authoritative record, an unresolved dispatch intent, and stale durable progress; the CLI driver only prints and exits 1.
findings.remediationSketch: Wrap the node dispatch/retry body to convert throws into classified failed results; resolve intents in finally with a reconciliation record; add an orchestrate()-level catch that emits a terminal receipt and flushes before rethrowing.

findings.title: Bootstrap verify exits 0 with ok:true for unsigned envelopes (recorded, publication-gated deviation)
findings.explanation: An envelope with no signature field skips all crypto and reports ok:true/exit 0 with every integrity field attacker-supplied. Mitigations verified: strict gate CSM_BOOTSTRAP_REQUIRE_SIGNATURE=1 fails closed; malformed/bad signatures fail closed; the result honestly reports signed:false; the deviation is recorded in deferred.md DEF-RELEASE and the publication runbook; and the shipped keyring is a fixture (F-007) so verification confers no production trust today.
findings.impact: Tooling gating on ok/exit 0 treats unsigned local envelopes as trusted; the risk is bounded by the recorded publication gate but remains a machine-contract trap.
findings.remediationSketch: Invert default to require signature with an explicit --allow-unsigned; or emit ok:false with a distinct unsigned code for tooling; keep the recorded deviation note current until publication.

challenges.rationale: Behavior confirmed but recorded and publication-gated: strict flag fails closed, malformed/bad signatures fail closed, result reports signed:false, deviation recorded in deferred.md and publication runbook, and the shipped keyring is a fixture (F-007) so verification confers no production trust regardless.

findings.statusNote: Challenger downgrade accepted: recorded, publication-gated deviation with a working strict flag; scope limited to unsigned (no signature field) envelopes.

findings.title: Shipped trust anchor is a self-declared test-fixture keyring valid to 2030
findings.explanation: The bin's only trust root is fixture-2026 (Ed25519, revoked:false, valid 2026-01-01 to 2030-12-31). Signature verification can never confer production trust in the shipped state. Gating recorded: publication-runbook key ceremony (production_use true, embedded literal update) and pack --release refusing fixture markers; DEF-RELEASE covers rotation.
findings.impact: Even strict-mode verification proves only fixture custody; a retained or leaked fixture private key makes all verified envelopes forgeable.
findings.remediationSketch: Ship a real release keyring at publication (runbook step 3); refuse verify with a typed error when environment is test-fixture-only outside explicit fixture mode.

findings.title: Every telemetry event persists the full progress document; the store rescans all prior snapshots per write
findings.explanation: emitTelemetry -> observeTelemetry bumps revision and persists the whole document per event; saveProgress rescans and re-sorts all prior progress-snapshot rows inside each write transaction and nothing prunes them - O(n^2) over long runs, widening the SQLITE_BUSY window that feeds F-003.
findings.impact: Long or chatty runs degrade progressively and increase the probability of the persist-failure deadlock.
findings.remediationSketch: Decouple eventsObserved from document revision (debounced or phase-boundary counter); compact progress state into a dedicated row or prune superseded snapshot events.

findings.title: An in-flight poller tick survives stopPoll() and can roll up after the node finalized
findings.explanation: clearInterval does not cancel a tick already awaiting findChildSkillProgress; after executeNode's authoritative updates the stale tick still runs rollupChildProgress from its earlier snapshot, re-writing verifiedFraction/evidenceRefs and emitting telemetry attributed to a returned child.
findings.impact: Post-finalization fraction/evidence churn and revision bumps attributed to a settled child; contained by the percent-100 skip but observable on partials.
findings.remediationSketch: Generation-guard the stop handle (stopped flag checked after each await in the tick) or track and await/abort the tick promise in stop.

findings.title: Child skill-progress records are written non-atomically; torn reads are silently skipped by rollup
findings.explanation: The CLI writes records in place (no temp+rename while lib/durable-json provides atomicWrite/withLock), and both rollup readers catch {} around JSON.parse - a torn read yields null and the rollup silently no-ops; an invalid record's TypeError is likewise swallowed.
findings.impact: Progress evidence can be silently lost mid-run; concurrent CLI updates lose updates.
findings.remediationSketch: Use atomicWrite for the record; wrap the CLI read-modify-write in withLock; emit a loss-style telemetry record when a rollup input fails validation instead of bare catch.

findings.title: An adapter throw skips resolveDispatchIntent: intent stuck pending, cursor stuck dispatching
findings.explanation: resolveDispatchIntent sits after the try/finally, so an adapter rejection propagates to Promise.all and out of orchestrate, leaving the dispatch intent pending, the cursor at dispatching, and the progress item durably active with no reconciliation record.
findings.impact: Operators reading dispatch_intents see a live dispatch that never happened; resume reconciliation covers the cursor but not the intent table.
findings.remediationSketch: Resolve the intent in finally (cancelled after recording a reconciliation event, or introduce an unknown resolution); wrap batch node errors so sibling results still reconcile.

findings.title: Plan input digest verification fails open when a payload carries no digest fields; dead ddd branch

Partially mitigated: load() enforces requireSourceDigest for non-plan path inputs, so the fail-open bites machine/object inputs and plans. The kind === 'ddd' check at line 140 is unreachable (early return at 91-108).

findings.title: recordSkillProgress joins childRunId into a file path with only a remote, schema-level guard
findings.anchorRef: OWASP ASVS v5.0.0 validation chapter (owasp.org, retrieved 2026-09-06)

findings.title: run-g7-evaluation --out builds mkdir target through a file:// URL string
findings.anchorRef: OWASP ASVS v5.0.0 validation chapter (owasp.org, retrieved 2026-09-06)
findings.explanation: For a relative --out, file://evidence/g7.json parses 'evidence' as the URL host so .pathname is / - the mkdir silently succeeds at the wrong place while the write lands cwd-relative; spaces/#/? break the parse.
findings.impact: Evidence bundles can land in unintended locations; the emitted out: line can misreport the destination.
findings.remediationSketch: Use path.resolve + mkdir(path.dirname(abs)) without URL round-tripping.

findings.title: Host scripts derive root by raw string-strip of import.meta.url instead of fileURLToPath
quotedSnippets: const root = join(import.meta.url.replace(/* strip file:// prefix */), "..", "..").replace(/slash-dollar, "");
findings.explanation: A checkout path containing a space or non-ASCII character keeps %20-style encoding in root, so exec cwd and readdir target nonexistent directories - the host throws or silently collects zero signals. Two hosts affected; the bootstrap bin already uses fileURLToPath.
findings.impact: Degrades the quality gate's evidence on such checkouts; errors fail closed rather than misbehave dangerously.
findings.remediationSketch: Use dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) matching the bootstrap pattern.
findings.statusNote: Upheld after independent challenge / primary verification at the pinned SHA. Confidence capped at medium: static-evidence class (E3) with primary-led challenge only.

findings.title: adapter-required-tests spawns children with no timeout - a hung child stalls the required-test gate forever
findings.explanation: Unlike osv-audit's defaultRunProcess (which sets and clears a kill timer), this runner has no timeout/kill path and accumulates output unbounded.
findings.impact: A wedged browser-e2e child blocks CI indefinitely instead of failing the gate.
findings.remediationSketch: Add signal: AbortSignal.timeout(N) (or a cleared kill timer) to both spawns.

findings.title: SHELL_DENYLIST is a bypassable advisory lint, not a security control
findings.explanation: Whitespace, casing tricks, homoglyphs, or synonyms defeat it. The bin never executes steps, so impact is bounded; the risk is false assurance if a future consumer treats passing steps as safe-to-run.
findings.impact: Signals shell-safety the check cannot deliver.
findings.remediationSketch: Reframe as a structured steps format with an allowlist, or document the check as best-effort lint only.
findings.statusNote: Upheld after independent challenge / primary verification at the pinned SHA. Confidence capped at medium: static-evidence class (E3) with primary-led challenge only.

findings.title: Retry backoff sleeps double the intended schedule and ignore abort
findings.explanation: retryDecision returns nextAttempt = attempt + 1, so the first retry (attempt 2) waits 2x retryBackoffMs; the sleep is not raced against the abort signal and is not unref'd, so an aborted run blocks for the full backoff.
findings.impact: Aborted runs linger; backoff grows faster than designed.
findings.remediationSketch: Use attempt - 2 exponent (or pass prior attempt), add jitter, race against the signal, unref the timer.
findings.statusNote: Upheld after independent challenge / primary verification at the pinned SHA. Confidence capped at medium: static-evidence class (E3) with primary-led challenge only.

findings.title: Four suites duplicate the same fixture host and driver happy path; presence-only assertions; MV-D leaks evidence into...
findings.explanation: Four ~60-line fixture hosts differ only in id strings; four suites spawn the full driver to re-prove VERIFIED with 120s timeouts; several assertions are presence-only (md.length > 200); MV-D writes evidence under the repo tree and never cleans it (gitignored, so it accumulates invisibly).
findings.impact: Fixture-shape changes require 4-5 coordinated edits; suite cost grows; weak assertions cannot detect wrong-content regressions.
findings.remediationSketch: Canonical fixture module + thin wrappers; one shared driver harness with a tight timeout; assert field-label/value pairs; clean the evidence dir in finally.
findings.statusNote: Upheld after independent challenge / primary verification at the pinned SHA. Confidence capped at medium: static-evidence class (E3) with primary-led challenge only.
